The '''''Iron Sun''''' was a [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer]] that served with the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] prior to the [[Sith–Imperial War]].

==History==
In [[127 ABY]], the ''Iron Sun'' was tasked with patrolling the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], where it captured the ancient [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Celeste Morne]], a "[[Covenant Shadow|Shadow]]" of the [[Jedi Covenant]] from the time of the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], who had exiled herself in hopes of keeping the even-more ancient [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Karness Muur]] prisoner, used the power of the [[Muur Talisman]] to transform the ship's crew into [[rakghoul]]s, [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] bound to her will via the [[Muur Talisman]]. The vessel, derelict and adrift, remained there for ten years, until it was "rediscovered" by [[Cade Skywalker]] and the crew of the [[Mynock (Helot-class)|''Mynock'']] in [[137 ABY]].

This was, in fact, organized by Morne, who used the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] to pull the ''Mynock'' from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. Upon landing to investigate, Skywalker, along with [[Shado Vao]], [[Jariah Syn]], [[Deliah Blue]], and [[Imperial Knight]]s [[Antares Draco]], [[Ganner Krieg]] and [[Azlyn Rae]] were confronted and separated by Morne and her rakghouls. It was from there that the Jedi and Imperials organized the [[Mission to Had Abbadon|luring]] of [[Darth Krayt]] into a [[Battle on Had Abbadon|trap]] meant to end the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] life.
